title: Pixel Jumper
description: Run, jump and squash slimes across three colourful levels in this retro pixel platformer. Collect coins, dodge the spikes and reach the flag at the end of each stage.
instructions: Move left and right with the arrow keys or A and D.
Jump with Space, the up arrow or W. Hold jump to jump higher.
On a phone or tablet, use the on-screen ◀ ▶ and jump buttons.
Jump on top of slimes to squash them. Touching them from the side or landing on spikes sends you back to the start of the level.
Reach the red flag to finish the level. Press P to pause.
